Exact null cancel returns post-pl3-orders-only, no new PL point.

Both truthy and equal exact stop times -> ambiguous null proposal. Cancellation truthy and winner null or strictly later -> cancellation wins. Exact PL switches to PH after setting cancellation gate/cursor. Other phase with truthy existing lows requires prior-low penetration check. findings.description: This branch replaces rather than extends the post-secondary3 list, preserving eligible candidate encounter order. It precedes the normal equal-stop ambiguity test; a candidate equal to cancellation is excluded.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.

findings.description: On cancellation, the phase and gate/cursor changes are local speculative registers. Existing secondary lows require an actual strict penetration of the previous low, not merely the MBL floor. The last RAW timestamp at or before cursor is read directly.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.

findings.description: The winner snapshot is passed directly into the logical point. Only a point-producing return updates the prospective gate, cursor, phase and reset flag; the global scheduler owns commitment.
findings.resolution: Clarify active source-derived contract; no production change.
